title: Tastes Like Mud
description: Tastes Like Mud — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Take the cup of stolen coffee into Balzack's Burrow and drink it to find out why it is so much better than normal coffee.

Quest Reward: None listed in the client files

Return to: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Bean Steamer

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Take the cup of stolen coffee into Balzack's Burrow and drink it to find out why it is so much better than normal coffee.

Offer:

Whoa, do you smell that? What a stench, that must be why the monsters in Balzack's Burrow love this stuff. Take this cup of coffee in the dance club and drink it. Let me know if it makes you dance when you drink it. Come back when you are done.

Turn-in:

Just as I expected, they are dancing to the music of the eighties. They have to puke just to keep from dying on the inside.

Objectives:

  • Drink the Coffee
  • Drink the Coffee and bring it back. ×1

Client level range: 55–100
